facts.text: Automation APIs enable company setup automation using delegated admin credentials or Business Central users with appropriate permissions.
Create company via POST to automationCompany endpoint with name, displayName, businessProfileId parameters.
Upload RapidStart package by first creating configuration package with POST, then uploading file with PATCH to content endpoint.
Import RapidStart via POST Microsoft.NAV.import bound action, then apply via POST Microsoft.NAV.apply bound action.
User groups deprecated in version 25 replaced by security groups for managing user permissions.
Extensions installed via Microsoft.NAV.install bound action or unpublished via Microsoft.NAV.unpublish introduced in version 25.4.
Per-tenant extension upload and install via Automation APIs supported only in SaaS, not on-premises.
Features activated or deactivated through Microsoft.NAV.activate and Microsoft.NAV.deactivate bound actions on feature endpoint.
